cells.source_claim: Retired (loss of standing) is never conferred by workflow words; only explicit ARB decisions create governance

context.scope: governance status of engineering artifacts (ES-001.2, ARB rule)

cells.notes: ES-001.2 makes every governance status, including Promoted and Retired, performative: created only by an explicit ARB decision; records do not create it. Mapping governance status onto MT 'ad' is an interpretation (hence MEDIUM).

cells.source_claim: same: no status change without an explicit decision

context.scope: governance status of engineering artifacts (ES-001.2, ARB rule)

cells.notes: ES-001.2 makes every governance status, including Promoted and Retired, performative: created only by an explicit ARB decision; records do not create it. Mapping governance status onto MT 'ad' is an interpretation (hence MEDIUM). Automatic loss on evidence change would be a status change without a decision.

cells.source_claim: a named authority adopts; decisions are per item (Approve / Reject / Defer)

context.scope: governance status of engineering artifacts (ES-001.2, ARB rule)

cells.notes: Names the adopting authority and per-item granularity. MT has no authority/scope variable, so this is CANNOT-EXPRESS for the family.

cells.exact_wording: produces a superseding version of this dictionary
cells.source_claim: a changed definition requires an ADR and produces a superseding version; never silent redefinition
cells.notes: A defined act (ADR, then supersession) changes a frozen artifact, but no evidence trigger is stated; it cannot decide 'later evidence overturns adoption'.
